description: This file contains utility functions for sending various types of emails (workspace addition, invitation, password reset, email verification) using nodemailer and handlebars templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplate
methods.description: Reads and returns an email template file, either custom or default.

methods.name: sendWorkspaceAdd
methods.description: Sends an email notifying a user they have been added to a workspace.

methods.name: sendWorkspaceInvite
methods.description: Sends an invitation email to join a workspace, customized based on platform and invite type.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetEmail
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a reset link.

methods.name: sendVerificationEmailForCloud
methods.description: Sends an email to verify user's email address.
